name: Suzunomiya Rikka
source:
Rikka is a medical doctor who work at the hospital of the city. 

She seems to be in her late 30s.

[spoiler]She is the "mother" of [url=https://vndb.org/c14895]Meta[/url] and is the legal guardian of [url=https://vndb.org/c14898]Mayuki[/url]. Because she take care of [url=https://vndb.org/c14898]her[/url] since 15 years, they've develop a special relationship, they love each other very much, like a mother and her daughter. 

She was always a student at the time of the disaster. At that time, she had cared for some survivors and remembered taking care of a very [url=https://vndb.org/c69174]young boy[/url] with a [url=https://vndb.org/c14897]baby[/url] whom she loved very much. She recognizes [url=https://vndb.org/c69174]Yukito[/url] and tells him that she is happy to see that he has "grown up" well.[/spoiler]
